description: PSX trading calendar used by session-completeness grading and gap detection (engines/market_calendar.py).
maintenance: Owner-maintained. Add each public holiday, special session, closure or change of hours only from an official PSX notice, with the notice reference in 'source'. Never add an unverified entry.

regular_hours_note: Window from the start of pre-open to the end of the post-close session, as published on the PSX Trading Hours page: Monday-Thursday pre-open 09:15, open 09:32-15:30, post-close 15:35-15:50; Friday pre-open 09:00, 1st session 09:17-12:00, 2nd session pre-open 14:15, open 14:32-16:30, post-close 16:35-16:50 (PKT). The Friday break is detected from the data, without false alerts. Applied only to 1-minute bars. Seasonal (e.g. Ramadan) timings: not recorded; add from the PSX notice when issued.

holidays_note: Only fixed-date holidays from the PSX 2026 list are recorded. Moon-dependent holidays on that list (Juma-tul-Wida, Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Azha, Ashura, Eid Milad-un-Nabi) are 'subject to appearance of moon' and are added only from the PSX notice that confirms each date. The page shows no notice number; it states PSX may modify the dates.

open_sessions._note: Official OPEN trading sessions (PKT). The autonomous fetcher fetches only inside these. Friday has a Jumma break 12:00-14:32 (no trading) between its two sessions.
